newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Powerful quake rocks Colombia, damage minor.
newsitem.headline: Powerful quake rocks Colombia, damage minor.

text.p: A powerful eathquake rocked central-western Colombia on Wednesday but there were no immediate reports of serious damage or injuries, authorities said.
The national seismological institute said the quake, which measured 5.97 on the Richter scale, struck at about 1:26 p.m. (1826 GMT) and was powerful enough to cause severe damage in a populated area.
Its epicentre was located near the town of Sipi, a jungle area in the foothills of the Andes mountains in western Choco province, a spokesman for the institute said.

He said the tremor, which originated 60 miles (100 km) beneath the earth's surface, was felt in neighbouring provinces of Valle del Cauca and Antioquia and the central provinces of Caldas, Risaralda and Quindio.
National radio reported minor damage, including broken windows in office buildings in Pereira and Armenia, cities nestled in the heart of Colombia's central coffee-growing region.
